List the curated tables of KNBS reports

Source: R/reports.R
knbs_report_tables.Rd

KNBS publishes some of its data only as tables printed in PDF reports. This lists the tables the package has curated: each has a hand-checked recipe - the report, the title it is found by, its columns, its unit and figures read by hand - so that knbs_report_table() can return it as tidy observations, or refuse with a clear error if the report has changed.

Curated so far: the Gross County Product reports of 2019, 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2025 - county GDP at current and constant prices, each county's share of gross value added, per-capita GCP (2019) and the county population tables (2024, 2025).

Usage

knbs_report_tables(series = NULL)

Arguments

series

Keep only these report series, for example "gcp".

Value

A knbs_catalogue tibble with columns table_id, series, edition, publisher, printed, title, measure, prices, base_year, unit, periods and report.

See also

knbs_report_table(), knbs_gcp(), knbs_county_population()

Examples

knbs_report_tables()
#> <knbs_catalogue>
#> Title: KNBS report tables: curated
#> Rows: 30
#> Source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
#> 
#> # A tibble: 30 × 12
#>    table_id      series edition publisher printed title measure prices base_year
#>    <chr>         <chr>    <int> <chr>     <chr>   <chr> <chr>   <chr>      <int>
#>  1 gcp-2019-cur… gcp       2019 Kenya Na… Table 4 Gros… gcp     curre…        NA
#>  2 gcp-2019-sha… gcp       2019 Kenya Na… Table 5 Coun… gva_sh… NA            NA
#>  3 gcp-2019-con… gcp       2019 Kenya Na… Table 6 Gros… gcp     const…      2009
#>  4 gcp-2019-per… gcp       2019 Kenya Na… Table 7 Per … gcp_pe… curre…        NA
#>  5 gcp-2019-per… gcp       2019 Kenya Na… Table 8 Per … gcp_pe… const…      2009
#>  6 gcp-2021-cur… gcp       2021 Kenya Na… Table 1 Gros… gcp     curre…        NA
#>  7 gcp-2021-con… gcp       2021 Kenya Na… Table 2 Gros… gcp     const…      2016
#>  8 gcp-2021-sha… gcp       2021 Kenya Na… Table 3 Coun… gva_sh… NA            NA
#>  9 gcp-2023-cur… gcp       2023 Kenya Na… Table 1 Gros… gcp     curre…        NA
#> 10 gcp-2023-sha… gcp       2023 Kenya Na… Table 2 Coun… gva_sh… NA            NA
#> # ℹ 20 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: unit <chr>, periods <chr>, report <chr>
